messages:
elaine: Hey team — final pass on the launch post assets. Need: hero image, 2 social snips, SEO meta, HubSpot form wiring, and legal ok on benchmark callouts. Publishing Wed 09:00 PT. Who can own what by EOD?

matt: Ill take HubSpot wiring + UTM conventions. Will attach form ID and tracking script to the doc in 20.

rachel: I can do hero image + 3 social-ready crops. Uploading to /assets/launch-images now. Anyone have alt text requests?

acc-bot: Reminder: all public images must have alt text <=125 chars and color contrast check passed.

rachel: Added alt: "Redwood Inference console showing model routing dashboard". Toss me edits if too long.

jamal: Hero H1 draft in doc: "Make inference predictable for production." H2 options there too. Prefer shorter H1 for theme.

ngozi: I'll draft two social snips and headline variants. Also a short CEO quote option if Jamal wants to replace hero.

legal-bot: Scan result: benchmark sentence "50% lower TCO" flagged. Please provide internal benchmark link or soften to "up to 50%" or cite scope.

elaine: Kevin's bench data is in /analysis/benchmarks/launch-v3.csv — can we reference that publicly, or do we need to redact model IDs?

ngozi: We should keep language scoped and non-comparative. Suggest: "In internal tests, Redwood reduced per-token latency by up to 30% on common LLM workloads."

matt: Form ID added: hs_form_9832. UTMs: utm_campaign=rdw_launch_v3, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Added fallback param to persist on redirects.

rachel: Uploaded hero + three crops: hero-01.jpg (1200x628), hero-01-square.jpg (1080x1080), hero-01-card.jpg (1200x630). Tagged with alt text.

seo-bot: Suggested meta description: "Redwood Inference: production-ready LLM serving with predictable latency, cost controls, and unified deployment modes. Read launch benchmarks." Keep under 155 chars.

jamal: Edited H1 to "Predictable LLM inference for production" and trimmed H2. Jamal: added CEO quote: "We built Redwood so teams could treat inference as reliable infrastructure, not guesswork."

legal-bot: CEO quote ok. Benchmark language must include link to internal report. Please add: /analysis/benchmarks/launch-v3.csv and use "internal tests" phrasing.

elaine: Updated doc with internal link and softened claim to "up to 30% in internal tests". Also added author byline and publish time.

matt: Confirmed tracking snippet works on staging with hs_form_9832. QA: please confirm conversions fire.

publish-bot: Smoke publish test queued for 2026-03-25T08:45:00Z on staging. I will post results.

acc-bot: Ran contrast check on hero images: hero-01-card.jpg fails 3:1 on button overlay. Rachel, recommend adjusting overlay or button color.

rachel: Will adjust overlay and re-upload within 1 hour.

ngozi: Drafted social snippets and short LinkedIn author blurbs in the doc. Two tone options (technical + product).

elaine: Quick checklist: 
- [ ] Legal benchmark signoff (legal-bot / sara)
- [ ] Hero image accessibility fix (rachel)
- [ ] HubSpot form & UTMs (matt)
- [ ] SEO meta + meta image (seo-bot / ngozi)
- [ ] Social snips + CEO quote (ngozi/jamal)
- [ ] Smoke publish on staging (publish-bot)

elaine: Please mark done in doc by EOD. If all green I'll lock publish slot Wed 09:00 PT. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
